captions.detailed: A classroom-style monocular microscope with a light-gray rectangular base, a vertical support arm, and a black square specimen stage. The optical head assembly is mounted on a vertical sliding guide on the arm, complete with coarse and fine focusing knobs on the side. A rotating objective turret houses multiple objective lenses above the stage, which features a sliding slide-holder carriage.
captions.instruction: Generate a classroom monocular microscope with a rectangular base, a curved vertical arm, a specimen stage, and an optical head. Incorporate a prismatic joint for the head carriage sliding vertically on the arm, a continuous rotation joint for the objective turret, a prismatic joint for the stage carriage, and independent continuous rotation joints for the coarse and fine focus knobs.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope using an ArticulatedObject builder. Create a rectangular base and a vertical column arm using Box and Cylinder primitives. Model the optical head carriage assembly and slide stage, attaching them with prismatic joints (for vertical focusing and stage carriage movement). Define the revolving objective turret with a continuous rotation joint, and add independent cylindrical coarse and fine focus knobs with continuous rotation joints on the side of the arm guide.
